question: Which of the following schemes aims to provide assured income support to small and marginal farmers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)** was officially launched on **24th February 2019** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** at **Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It is a **Central Sector Scheme** which receives **100% funding** from the **Government of India** to provide income support to farmers.
 
• Under this scheme, an income support of **₹6,000 per year** is provided to all landholding farmer families across the **country** to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture.
 
• The financial benefit is credited directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries through **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** mode in **three equal installments** of **₹2,000** every **four months**. *Hence, option D is correct.*
